newsitem.title: USA: Galoob declines NYSE request for statement.
newsitem.headline: Galoob declines NYSE request for statement.

text.p: The New York Stock Exchange said on Tuesday it had asked Galoob Toys Inc to issue a public statement in response to unusual market activity in its stock, but the company declined to comment.
Analysts said the stock fell sharply because Lucasfilm Ltd invited competitors to bid for the Star Wars toy license.
Galoob opened at 16-1/2 but was trading at 13-1/8 late in the day.
The New York exchange said Galoob would not comment because it was not its policy to comment on unusual market activity or rumors.
